name: Adachi Morinaga
source:
He is a fierce general in the shogunate, and he and Yorimoto has known each other since childhood.

Even though he looks like a gentle elder brother, he likes gambling, and solving problems using strong force. Because he is a natural, he knows a lot of people. He is not only good at fighting, but also information collection.

Organization: Kamakura Bakufu
Interests: Gambling, Playing kemari aggressively
